title: Place text at a selected visual location
preconditions: Open pr-1 greeting slide and show annotation tools.

steps.action: Choose Sticky note, click at 40% slide width/height, enter Original note and save.
steps.expected_result: A visible note reads Original note.

steps.action: Inspect the note position before and after reload and viewport resize.
steps.expected_result: It remains anchored at the chosen normalized location over the slide.

expected_result: It remains anchored at the chosen normalized location over the slide.
